body:
A Sephora gift card can be used to pay for your order at One Stop Vape Store, and it qualifies for our 10% gift card discount. It is a good option if you already have a Sephora e-gift card, or if you prefer to buy a card from a familiar retailer instead of using cryptocurrency or a payment app. This guide explains how to buy the card, where to find the number and PIN, how to upload them through our private link, how to handle amounts that do not match, what happens after you upload and how to keep your card protected. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Buy the card
Go to the official [Sephora gift card page](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/gift-cards) and choose an e-gift card for the exact amount due. Send it to your own email so you receive the card number and PIN. The amount due is in our order email, and the order summary shows it before you place the order. Use Sephora's own site, or a retailer you trust, because cards from marketplace sellers may be stolen or already used.

## Locate the details
Open the delivery email and copy the card number and the PIN. Take a screenshot of the email too, in case you need to resend it. A Sephora e-gift card has a longer card number and a shorter PIN, and both are needed for it to be verified. Check each digit before you move on. If you bought a physical card, follow the instructions on the back. Some physical cards hide the PIN under a scratch-off strip, so read the instructions before you reveal it, and take clear photos.

## Upload to us
Use the private order link from our email. Enter both the number and the PIN in the code box, separating them with a space, then add your screenshot and receipt. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has it can open the page, and uploads are private. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on clear images. If you bought more than one card to reach the amount, add each number, PIN and receipt.

## If the amounts do not match
Gift card denominations are fixed. If the amount due is not available, buy the nearest higher amount and tell us in the notes. We will review the difference with you. If the amount due is larger than the maximum for a single card, buy two or more and upload them all. Please do not buy a much larger card than you need, because we cannot return unused balance to you.

## What happens next
We verify the balance and mark your order as paid. This is a manual check by our team, so it is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. You receive a confirmation email and your order enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. It then ships with tracking by USPS or UPS, and an adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) and [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## A worked example
Suppose your cart is $120. Paying with a gift card applies the 10% discount of $12.00, so the product total is $108.00. Because that is under $200, the flat $15 shipping fee applies, and the amount due is $123.00. Sephora e-gift cards are offered in set amounts, so you might buy a $125 card and tell us in the notes. You upload the number, PIN and receipt through the private link. For comparison, the same cart paid by Apple Pay has no discount and totals $135.00. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) for how the free-shipping line works.

## Avoid problems
- Buy only from Sephora's official site.
- Do not scratch or reveal a physical PIN before checking the instructions on the card.
- Never post the card number publicly.
- Do not use the card yourself once you have decided to pay with it.
- Keep the email and the receipt until we confirm.

## Common problems
### The card is not accepted
Check that you entered both the number and the PIN, separated by a space, and that each digit is correct. If it still fails, contact us with your order number and a screenshot of the receipt.

### The balance is lower than expected
If the card was used or partly used, tell us right away. We will let you know what is needed, which may be a second card.

### I did not receive the email from Sephora
Check spam, check the address you entered when buying and use the order confirmation from Sephora to resend it.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I use a Sephora card I already have?
Yes, if it is unused, you own it and the balance matches the amount due. Do not use any of the balance first.

### Is a Sephora card slower than crypto?
Usually, because a person checks each card. See [gift card or crypto, which is better](/blog/gift-card-vs-crypto-which-is-better/).

### What about a card I received as a gift?
You can use it if it is one of our supported brands and you are its rightful owner. Make sure the balance is intact.

## Other card options
Compare with [Apple](/blog/pay-with-apple-gift-card/), [Macy's](/blog/pay-with-macys-gift-card/), [paysafecard](/blog/pay-with-paysafecard/) and [Razer Gold](/blog/pay-with-razer-gold/).

## Related guides
See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/). Browse the [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) range when you are ready. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Understanding fixed denominations
Gift cards are sold in set amounts, and that shapes how you plan a Sephora gift card payment. Start from the amount due in our order email, then look at the amounts the seller offers. If the exact figure is there, buy it. If not, you have three sensible options. The first is to buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes, which keeps the purchase simple at the cost of a small surplus that we cannot return. The second is to combine two cards that add up to the amount, for example one larger card and one small one, and upload both. The third is to adjust your cart slightly, adding or removing an item so that the amount due lands on an available denomination, which you can do before you pay by contacting us. Whichever you choose, tell us in the notes so that the person verifying your payment knows what to expect. Mismatches that are explained up front are resolved quickly, while unexplained ones take longer.

## Planning the timing of a Sephora gift card order
A gift card order has two phases, and it helps to plan around both. The first phase is yours: buying the card, finding the details and uploading them, which usually takes ten to twenty minutes if you have a payment method ready. The second phase is ours: a person checks the card and matches it to your order, which is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you place the order in the evening, buy the card straight away and upload it, and expect the check the next business morning. If you place it on a Friday afternoon, expect the check on Monday. Orders begin processing only after the payment is confirmed, so the sooner you upload, the sooner the 24 to 72 business hours of processing start. Unpaid orders may be released after 24 hours, so do not leave the purchase until the last minute.

## Number and PIN: why both matter
A Sephora gift card has two parts that work together: a card number and a PIN. The number identifies the card and the PIN proves you have it. We need both to verify the balance, and a card cannot be checked with only one of them. When you enter them in the code field, put the number first and the PIN second, separated by a space, and double-check every digit. If the PIN is under a scratch-off strip on a physical card, reveal it gently and photograph it straight away. If the PIN is shown in an email, a screenshot is enough. If either part is unreadable in your image, we will ask you to resend it, which slows things down.

## A final checklist for a Sephora gift card payment
1. Buy from Sephora's official gift card page.
2. Send it to your own email.
3. Copy both the number and the PIN.
4. Upload both, plus the screenshot and receipt, through the private link.
5. Do not use any balance yourself.

If everything on the list is ticked, your payment should be verified without any questions. If something is unclear, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp before you upload, and we will help. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

### Can I split the amount across two Sephora cards?
Yes. Upload both numbers and PINs with both receipts, and tell us in the notes that the payment is split. We add the balances together when we verify the order.

### What if the card arrives late?
E-gift cards normally arrive within minutes. If yours is delayed, check spam and the address you entered, and use the order confirmation from Sephora to resend it. Do not upload anything until you actually hold the card details.
